purpose: Replace the numerically contaminated historical alpha-coordinate v0.77 first-order bath-drive history by a full-history eta=0 trace generated with the already certified exact GE15 cancellation-free state s=chi/Q, and certify the resulting retarded z10 boundary at a=0.4 before any q20 rerun.

frozen_interpretation.ge14_mechanism: Historical alpha-coordinate chi=Q(a theta/k^2+alpha) is seeded by machine-epsilon cancellation under large early-time KQ; the cancellation-induced seed dominates the physical finite-gradient source at the first accepted endpoints.
frozen_interpretation.ge15_resolution: Use the exact coordinate change s=chi/Q, alpha=s-a theta/k^2, chi=Q s with s_i=0. No physics coefficient or state dimension changes.
frozen_interpretation.repair25_localization: GE15 and Repair22/GE19 agree to machine precision at a=0.4, while the historical v0.77 chi/a amplitude is incompatible and cannot be repaired by one frozen simple convention factor.
frozen_interpretation.prohibited_inference: Do not interpret the Repair25 per-mode fitted amplitudes as a physical Fourier normalization map.

frozen_model.Fourier_mode_amplitudes_and_phases: unchanged frozen GE19/Repair22 deterministic six-mode realization

reconstruction.bath_drive: X=chi/a, then multiply by the frozen positive-mode spatial gradient factor
reconstruction.retarded_history: integrate from the earliest valid accepted-source-grid node with z10=v10=0 to exactly a=0.4, including the final partial ln(a) step

pass_license.may_use: Frozen Repair26 R1 cancellation-free full-history trace and its derived retarded z10/v10 boundary as the only first-order bath parent in a separately preregistered q20 reconstruction rerun.
may_not_use: historical v0.77 chi trace as a physical boundary
